data.exact_reserve_text: In 2021, there has been an overall deficit in ultimate claims of GBP 15.8m (2020: deficit of GBP 2.0m) due primarily to an increase in US Winter storm Uri of GBP 8.4m on the 2020 year of account and a general increase in non-catastrophe claims estimates.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6103 reported a gross strengthening of GBP 15.8 million in ultimate claims for prior years, representing a 102.7% deterioration of its opening gross claims outstanding. This adverse development was primarily driven by an GBP 8.4 million increase related to US Winter storm Uri affecting the 2020 year of account, alongside a general increase in non-catastrophe claims estimates for prior years.
